claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens is not included or is damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the lens attached to the camera body, showing condition and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no lens

risks.risk: Shutter count may be high (e.g., over 100,000 shots)
risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count display on the camera screen or a screenshot from a shutter count tool.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown shutter count, which may be high

risks.risk: Camera may have been used in harsh conditions or has hidden wear
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the sensor, mirror, and body for scratches, dents, or mold.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the lens attached to the camera body.
Screenshot or photo of the shutter count display.
Close-up photos of the sensor, mirror, and body for damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
